geometry.distanceLabel: Distance from excavation centroid to CPT
geometry.label: Equivalent well (rectangular excavation)

notes.text: Sichardt radius of influence is shown as a screening estimate only. It is not a permit-grade hydrogeological prediction.

Hydraulic screening uses a transmissivity profile through the pumped interval: T = Σ(k_h · b). For unconfined flow, the radial drawdown is solved from the cumulative transmissivity moment rather than from one lumped k_h value.
Confined mode still needs project judgement: the app uses transmissivity over the interpreted pumped interval, but no separate aquifer-top input is available yet.
Realistic total-stress mode swaps gamma_sat to gamma between the old and new water tables. Conservative mode keeps sigma_v unchanged.
Total-stress mode sensitivity is negligible for this case: conservative = 100.44 mm, realistic = 100.44 mm. The pore-pressure reduction dominates the result here.

Equivalent-well mapping is active: the rectangular excavation area is converted to r_w,eq = sqrt(A/pi) = 13.82 m, and the Dupuit radial drawdown is then evaluated at the CPT distance from the excavation centroid.
Settlement time curve uses a simplified Terzaghi 1D two-way drainage assumption with Hd = half the interpreted layer thickness.
